reviewNotes: The first twenty-five map inspection strings, dialogue line, and book titles were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover room context, object descriptions, fictional product and author names, canonical world terms, dialogue controls, and natural Romanian; both found no remaining objective issue.

AnimalShop.1.source: Ah... an extra large futan bear! It's so plush it can hardly stop from toppling over.
AnimalShop.1.translation: Ah... un urs Futan uriaș! Este atât de pufos, încât abia se ține să nu se răstoarne.

AnimalShop.2.source: Ah... an extra large futan bear! It's so plush it can hardly stop from toppling over.
AnimalShop.2.translation: Ah... un urs Futan uriaș! Este atât de pufos, încât abia se ține să nu se răstoarne.

AnimalShop.3.translation: Carte de colorat Junimo -- Ediția de lux

AnimalShop.4.source: The little family is gathered around the dinner table. Wait... except Grandpa. He's wedged under the bed for some reason.
AnimalShop.4.translation: Micuța familie este adunată în jurul mesei. Stai... mai puțin Bunicul. Dintr-un motiv oarecare, este înțepenit sub pat.

AnimalShop.5.source: The little family is gathered around the dinner table. Wait... except Grandpa. He's wedged under the bed for some reason.
AnimalShop.5.translation: Micuța familie este adunată în jurul mesei. Stai... mai puțin Bunicul. Dintr-un motiv oarecare, este înțepenit sub pat.

AnimalShop.6.source: You rummage through Marnie's dresser. It's mostly long dresses, but there's a pair of brown suspenders in here as well.
AnimalShop.6.translation: Scotocești prin comoda lui Marnie. Sunt mai ales rochii lungi, dar se află aici și o pereche de bretele maro.

AnimalShop.7.source: You dig around in Marnie's private drawer. There's nothing of interest.
AnimalShop.7.translation: Scotocești prin sertarul personal al lui Marnie. Nu este nimic interesant.

AnimalShop.8.source: Looks like he's using the radio as an alarm clock.
AnimalShop.8.translation: Se pare că folosește radioul drept ceas deșteptător.

AnimalShop.9.source: Jack-in-the-box is sprawled out, his arms bent at grotesque angles. His hollow eyes peer coldly into the distance.
AnimalShop.9.translation: Păpușa cu arc zace întinsă, cu brațele îndoite în unghiuri grotești. Ochii ei goi privesc rece în depărtare.

AnimalShop.10.source: It's a Mega Station. There's a game in it, but it's routed through a Code Sultan XL. Looks like someone's been cheating.
AnimalShop.10.translation: Este un Mega Station. Are un joc instalat, dar acesta trece printr-un Code Sultan XL. Se pare că cineva a trișat.

AnimalShop.12.source: It's a mess of arts and crafts.
AnimalShop.12.translation: Este un talmeș-balmeș de materiale pentru lucru manual.

AnimalShop.13.source: It doesn't look used. Maybe it's a collector's ball.
AnimalShop.13.translation: Nu pare folosită. Poate că este o minge de colecție.

AnimalShop.15.source: There's an antique clock and a little golden trinket box.
AnimalShop.15.translation: Este un ceas de epocă și o cutiuță aurie pentru mărunțișuri.

AnimalShop.16.source: Doesn't seem like Jas uses this much.
AnimalShop.16.translation: Nu pare că Jas folosește prea des asta.

AnimalShop.19.source: Looks like someone was chopping vegetables but never finished.
AnimalShop.19.translation: Se pare că cineva toca legume, dar nu a mai terminat.

AnimalShop.20.source: Why are you looking through my trash can?$s
AnimalShop.20.translation: De ce îmi scotocești prin coșul de gunoi?$s

AnimalShop.21.translation: În mare parte cutii goale de pizza.
